  "limitations": [
    "Only summary statistics available—no paradigm-stratified means, standard deviations, or distributions to compare groups directly",
    "Extreme sample size imbalance across paradigms (range: 3,323 to 48,846) violates assumptions for standard ANOVA and may require weighted or hierarchical models",
    "Cannot assess interaction effects between stimulation type and individual mice due to lack of cross-tabulated data",

    "No information about trial sequence, learning effects, or session structure that could confound paradigm comparisons",
    "Temperature=0.75 and model=kimi with basic prompt template may affect reproducibility; no validation data or alternative model comparisons provided",
    "Unclear whether 'Sham' represents no stimulation or sensory-matched control; interpretation depends on sham procedure details not provided",
    "Single replication (run 28, replication 1) prevents assessment of stability across experimental sessions"
  ],
  "recommended_next_analysis": "Stratified descriptive statistics and visualizations by stimulation paradigm: compute mean, SD, and confidence intervals for all five performance variables within each paradigm, followed by inferential testing (mixed-effects models with mouse as random effect) to account for clustering. Specifically recommend: (1) boxplots/violin plots of Time-to-Target, Path Efficiency, and AD by paradigm to assess distributions and outliers; (2) logistic regression for Success with paradigm as predictor; (3) post-hoc pairwise comparisons with Tukey correction to identify which paradigms differ significantly, with careful attention to the underpowered Bright Visual Only and Sham conditions; (4) sensitivity analyses excluding extreme Path Efficiency outliers; and (5) subject-level analysis to quantify between-mouse versus between-paradigm variance components."
}
